Sign in to your Navigator account before testing. A captured and verified test payment automatically assigns a sandbox plan only. Sign in · My workspace

No real purchase or service activation.

Use only Razorpay test payment details. Paid workspaces are planned and are not activated by this test. Community posts and aliases are never sent to Razorpay.

Review the licence terms before payment

  • One licence, one authorised inquiry. A larger user allowance does not mean unlimited unrelated cases.
  • Accounts are not Committee quorum. Essential’s two users are application accounts. All legally required member participation must still be recorded; signed external records may be needed.
  • Every paid plan: its stated active term plus three months read-only, with controlled export and lawful custody. Expiry does not suspend statutory deadlines or automatically authorise record destruction.
  • Upgrades: applicable list-price difference; the existing licence term does not automatically restart.
  • Additional user proposal: ₹2,999 per case, subject to seat limits and the final policy. It is not an available checkout add-on.
  • Same-case remand, reopening and extensions: continuity and any additional terms must be disclosed in the written licence.
  • Intended activation policy: no voluntary refund after activation, subject to mandatory legal rights and remedies. Final licence/refund terms and seller details must be approved before live sales.

Final commercial terms, refunds and fulfilment must be agreed before any live purchase. Test payments create no paid account, invoice or entitlement.

Test orders use the listed base price in INR. GST is not calculated or invoiced in this simulation. Final tax treatment, commercial terms, refunds and fulfilment must be approved before any live checkout. Institutional Plus requires a proposal; Government / Enterprise requires a quotation.
